description: Create a draft weekly or monthly tracker: one measurement — rankings, compare, citations, or sentiment — applied to a list of prompts, with the brand, competitors and AI surfaces set once for all of them. When the user has no prompt list yet, run cite42_map_ai_prompts first and track the prompts it recommends. Creation does not start recurring calls. Tracker management and stored-report reads are free. Each scheduled or manual run bills one call per prompt at the normal per-model rates; the activation response and tracker record expose the accepted maximum cost per run. Present the returned USD amounts to users; activation still takes the exact estimatedCostMicroPerRun integer returned by the tracker.

brand.description: Required for compare and sentiment. Not used by rankings or citations.

monthday.description: Monthly trackers only. Day of month 1-31; a value past the end of a shorter month runs on that month's last day, so 31 always means "month end".

time.description: Local run time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/London or America/New_York.

weekday.description: Weekly trackers only. Day of week, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday.

competitors.description: Required for rankings (the brands to track, including your own) and compare (the rivals to rank against, up to 10). Not used by citations or sentiment.

models.description: AI surfaces to query for every prompt. Omit for the three defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini), or list surfaces explicitly — including all five — to fix the recurring cost.

primitive.description: What to measure on every prompt: rankings (which brands get named), compare (the brand against named competitors), citations (which sources are cited), or sentiment (how one brand is described). One measurement per tracker.

prompts.description: Prompts to track, up to 30. Each is billed as its own call on every run. Keep the wording stable so runs stay comparable, avoid dates, and do not repeat a prompt.

items.description: A prompt to run on every scheduled run.

url.description: Citations only: a URL to report on as cited or not cited.

name: cite42_tracker_create
